decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housing is a core component with its own website page and unresolved upside, so the option justifies its carrying cost.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's market and only recently launched, so uncertainty keeps the option alive.
Designer shower drainage fits the design-conscious positioning and has dedicated support, so the option remains worth holding.
Shower element with integrated slope supports core installation solutions and its prospect is still uncertain, so the option should be kept.
Backflow-protected basement floor drain received dedicated launch attention and covers a technical niche, so its option value persists.
Air-admittance valve lies outside the drainage core and has only a website mention, so with many other options its option has likely expired.
